2608.04926.title: Consistency-Driven Co-Evolution for Self-Supervised Cross-Representation Learning
2608.04926.paper_summary: As chart images, tabular data, and visualization code play increasingly important roles across diverse domains, cross-representation understanding across these modalities poses fundamental challenges for AI systems: the relationships across representations are inherently \textit{one-to-many}, supervision is ambiguous and costly, and model optimization lacks a principled signal that is both direction-adaptive and representation-generalizable beyond task-specific objectives. We introduce CoCoEvolve to improve consistency across chart, table, and code representations. Instead of treating cross-representation mapping as a one-to-many problem, we define explicit one-to-one correspondences and optimize models using agreement between representations, without additional annotations. During training, CoCoEvolve@Train performs co-evolution across the chart-table-code cycle, while CoCoEvolve@Test applies the same consistency objective at inference time for test-time co-optimization. We also present CoCoEvolve@Eval, an evaluation suite covering all six cross-representation tasks. Across four benchmarks, CoCoEvolve improves performance in both training-time and test-time settings. Our project page: https://xhguo7.github.io/CoCoEvolve/.
2608.04926.paper_summary_zh: 隨著圖表圖像、表格數據和可視化代碼在各個領域中扮演越來越重要的角色，這些模態之間的跨表示理解對於 AI 系統提出了根本性的挑戰：表示之間的關係本質上是 \textit{一對多}，監督是模糊且昂貴的，並且模型優化缺乏一個原則性的信號，該信號既能適應方向又能超越特定任務目標進行表示泛化。我們引入 CoCoEvolve 以改善圖表、表格和代碼表示之間的一致性。我們並不將跨表示映射視為一個一對多的問題，而是定義明確的一對一對應，並利用表示之間的協議來優化模型，而無需額外的註釋。在訓練期間，CoCoEvolve@Train 在圖表-表格-代碼循環中執行共同進化，而 CoCoEvolve@Test 在推理時應用相同的一致性目標，以進行測試時的共同優化。我們還展示了 CoCoEvolve@Eval，一個涵蓋所有六個跨表示任務的評估套件。在四個基準測試中，CoCoEvolve 在訓練時和測試時的設置中都提高了性能。我們的項目頁面：https://xhguo7.github.io/CoCoEvolve/。
